extension.description: Embed the DeepSeek Harness web UI in a VS Code editor panel.
configuration.binPath: Optional absolute path to the @deepseek-ai/dsh lib/bin.js entry point. Leave empty to detect it automatically.
configuration.nodePath: Optional absolute path to the system Node.js executable. Leave empty to detect it automatically.
configuration.args: Arguments passed to dsh. Any --port is overridden by the extension. Do not pass --public-url or TLS flags: the panel only works with the loopback http listener.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces: Starts a local DSH process and listens on a loopback port, so it cannot run in Restricted Mode.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces: Needs local filesystem access to locate the dsh and Node.js installations.
